decision.article_title: Microsoft、次世代AIチップ「Maia 300」詳細公開。ラック単位の処理量は最大7倍に - 株式会社インプレス
decision.reason: Microsoft's Maia 300 chips and announced faster rack-scale inference are internal proprietary compute hardware; constructing equivalent inference requires specialized hardware and external runtime AI services, contrary to Radar model-free application criteria.
